mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the rate level is inversely correlated with equity returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% in the most recent month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase equity risk aversion, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% indicates strong economic conditions that reduce recession risk and produce positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when the condition (INDPRO > 115.0 AND UNRATE < 5.0%) is met.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%), increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when the condition (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% AND CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%) is met.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, reducing recession risk and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of HOUST on 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 115.0 (a 3-month low), it signals a weakening economy that increases equity risk aversion, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) above 2150.0 and rising residential sales (RSAFS) above 350000.0 indicates strong consumer demand, reducing recession risk and producing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when the condition (HOUST > 2150.0 AND RSAFS > 350000.0) is met.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 5.0%), strong employment and consumer spending reduce equity risk, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when the condition (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM AND UNRATE < 5.0%) is met.
